about.title: About Me
about.textPart1: My name is Mikhail, I'm a Frontend Developer with experience in creating modern Single Page Applications using TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Redux, Redux Toolkit, and RTK Query. I specialize in developing efficient and maintainable web applications with a user-friendly and responsive interface.
about.textPart2: I'm constantly expanding my technical stack, currently learning backend technologies (Node.js) and planning to master Vue and React Native in the near future. To keep my algorithmic thinking sharp, I regularly solve challenges on Codewars and other platforms.
about.textPart3: In my work, I adhere to key development principles such as clean maintainable code and responsive design. You can learn more about my approach in the
about.textPart4: section. I'm open to various cooperation formats - office, remote, hybrid, or flexible hours.

todoList.title: Todo List App
todoList.description: Task management application built with React and TypeScript. Features include adding, editing, filtering tasks by status (active/completed), and persistent storage using localStorage. Includes dark/light theme toggle.

ecommerce.title: E-commerce Store
ecommerce.description: Online store prototype with product catalog, shopping cart, and checkout. Fetches product data from FakeStore API, implements user authentication with Firebase, and includes basic cart functionality.

social-network.title: Social Network
social-network.description: Social media web application with core features: user registration and authentication, post feed, user profiles. Team development using modern practices.
